newsitem.title: USA: GreenPoint ups dividend, buys back shares.
newsitem.headline: GreenPoint ups dividend, buys back shares.

text.p: GreenPoint Financial Corp said Tuesday it increased its quarterly dividend by $0.05, to $0.25 a share.
The company also said it was instituting its fourth stock repurchase program since 1994, buying back five percent of its shares.
The 25 percent increase in the dividend is the first since GreenPoint began paying dividends in 1994. It is payable March 5 to shareholders of record on February 21.
GreenPoint also said it was establishing a dividend reinvestment plan available to shareholders beginning with the May dividend payable in June.
GreenPoint is a specialty home finance company and describes itself as the leading national lender in no- documentation mortgages.
